big: Buffalo's chance to win, our model (Chicago 43%)
How often tired road teams won when our model gave them 46%
note: Chicago creates the fewest chances in the NHL. But Buffalo played last night, and the model doesn't count that: road teams on the second night of a back-to-back, against a rested home team, have won 38% since 2023-24, against 47% when rested.

explainer.title: Second nights cost road teams.
explainer.text: Since 2023-24, road teams playing the second night in a row against a rested home team won 38% of 643 games. Rested road teams won 47%.
